snippet.title: Why GTA 6 Took 13 Years and Billions of Dollars?
snippet.description:
Why did GTA 6 take 13 years, and did it really cost $2 billion? We break down the rumored budget, what Rockstar and Take-Two have actually confirmed, how a game this big is built, the 2022 leak, the record-breaking trailers, the delays to November 19, 2026, and the business model that could make the money back. Includes a hypothetical break-even calculation and Take-Two's own FY2026 numbers.
